name: File Lock
description: Cooperative locking for concurrent agents in a shared worktree. Edit and Write get a sibling .locked file before they change a file. The plugin breaks a stale lock automatically (dead PID or a time threshold). The LockStatus tool examines the locks under the cwd, and the plugin gives a CLI for human use. To disable it, set `plugins["file-lock"].enabled = false` in `~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc`, or set the env var `MINIMAL_AGENT_FILE_LOCK_DISABLED=1`.

tool.name: LockStatus
tool.description:
Examine or clear the file locks of the agents, in the cwd and below it. Use it when `Edit` or `Write` gives a lock error. Use it to know which session has the lock on a file. To change a file, use `Edit` or `Write`. The tool gives the result of the `action`.

A lock error comes after some seconds of tries (default 30). Do not use `Edit` again immediately. Wait a short time, or use this tool. If the lock stays, show the data of the lock to the user. Then wait for the user to tell you.

action.description:
- `list`: show each lock in the tree, with the session, pid and host that have it, and the time since the lock started.
- `inspect`: show the data of one lock and its session.
- `clear-stale`: remove each lock of a stopped process, and each lock made more than 5 minutes before. The tool gives the number of removed locks.
- `clear`: remove one lock. This is dangerous when the peer continues to operate.

path.description: For `list` and `clear-stale`: the directory (default: the cwd). For `inspect` and `clear`: the full path of the locked file, not the `.locked` file.

format.description:
The default is `text`.
- `text`: ANSI lines for the transcript.
- `json`: data for a script.
